body.content: Exploration log: Grid-and-center at 2/7 boundary spacing yields min area 0.035714. Key sliver risk: any three collinear boundary points form area 0, so must skip every other segment. Triangular lattice suffers boundary truncation creating ~0.015 slivers at edges. Unifier approach: use corners + 8 edge points + center is dominant family; optimal spacing seems to be 2/7. Mechanist view: verify no three points collinear, compute all 286 areas exactly. Skeptic concern: irrational coordinates like sqrt(3)/4 may fail checker byte-verification if not rounded to 6 decimals properly.
body.why_keep_this: Tracks which grid spacings have been tried and their failure modes for future reference.
